contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [CONS]TANTINVS MAX [AVG] ; R/ [VICTORIAE] LAETAE PRINC P[ERP]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Victoriae Laetae Princ Perp issue of 318-320, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Helmeted head right. Obverse inscription: [CONS]TANTINVS MAX [AVG]. Reverse description: Two Victories resting shield inscribed VOT/PR on altar. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE] LAETAE PRINC P[ERP]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die axis: 6
